lines.en: Michael, I've had a very interesting conversation with one of your employees.
No, it wasn't. Dwight just told me that he thinks he can run the branch better than you.
What? You were at the dentist?
You can't have people undermining you. Get control of your branch immediately.
Okay. What was I thinking? That he could turn Jan against me?
Hey, Dwight. Hey. You want an M&M?
No, seriously. You should have an M&M. They're really good.
Hey, I thought you weren't supposed to eat anything for a couple of hours after you've had a crown put in.
They're having this new kind of quick-drying bonding.
Maybe that's why he became a dentist.
And I am like a tiger.
And Dwight is like a monkey that stabs the tiger in the back with a stick.
Does the tiger fire the monkey?
Does the tiger transfer the monkey to another branch?
There is no way of knowing what goes on inside the tiger's head.
